description:
About the job

Descripción del puesto Como Coord. Trade Marketing en Sweet Way, coordinarás y ejecutarás los planes de trade marketing para maximizar la visibilidad y rotación de nuestros productos en el punto de venta. En tu día a día, trabajarás con el equipo de mercaderistas y supervisores para definir acciones promocionales, adaptar materiales de comunicación y asegurar la correcta implementación en canal tradicional. También elaborarás reportes de desempeño, analizarás resultados de campañas y propondrás mejoras basadas en datos. Gestionarás el contacto con cadenas supervisando tiempos, presupuestos y calidad de las ejecuciones. Este es un puesto a jornada completa en modalidad híbrida, con base en Mérida, Yucatán, combinando trabajo presencial y tareas desde casa.

Requisitos

Aptitudes en planificación de mercado y trade marketing, con experiencia en la definición de estrategias para canales y puntos de venta.
Aptitudes analíticas sólidas para interpretar datos de ventas, participación de mercado y resultados de campañas, y transformarlos en acciones concretas.
Aptitudes en marketing y comunicación para diseñar materiales, mensajes promocionales y coordinar activaciones alineadas con la marca.
Formación universitaria en Marketing, Administración, Comunicación o similar, y experiencia previa en puestos de trade marketing o retail.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, gestionar varios proyectos a la vez, manejar herramientas ofimáticas y de análisis (Excel avanzado, dashboards), y alto nivel de organización.

description:
About the job

This role supports a growing portfolio of physician-led businesses spanning healthcare, education, media, publishing, and professional services. Key brands include Pinnacle Business Academy, Mindful Practice Podcast, Phoenix Medical Spa, Phoenix Ascend Press, and related ventures. The ideal candidate will focus on the day-to-day execution of the social media strategy.




Responsibilities:

· Build and maintain an organized content calendar across assigned brands and platforms.

· Create branded static graphics, short-form video/reels, promotional assets, engagement posts, and other platform-appropriate content.

· Write clear captions, hooks, calls to action, promotional copy, and audience-engagement copy that matches each brand.

· Repurpose podcasts, interviews, speaking appearances, webinars, articles, book content, educational material, and founder ideas into multiple social assets.

· Schedule and publish content consistently using approved workflows and platform tools.

· Maintain brand standards, including correct logos, colors, fonts, tone, audience, offer, and CTA for each business.

· Support community engagement, including Facebook-group prompts, comments, audience interaction, and basic moderation where assigned.

· Coordinate with the Operations & Systems VA when campaigns require landing pages, forms, automations, lead capture, or backend changes.

· Maintain an organized content library and asset bank so approved material can be efficiently reused and repurposed.

· Track basic performance metrics such as reach, engagement, follower growth, clicks, inquiries, and lead-driving content, and summarize meaningful trends.




Must Have Skills:

· Strong social-media content planning and calendar-management skills; must be capable of maintaining a consistent cadence without daily prompting.

· Excellent copywriting for captions, hooks, CTAs, promotional posts, and engagement content.

· Strong Canva or comparable visual-design capability, with demonstrated ability to follow an established brand rather than redesign it arbitrarily.

· Short-form video editing and repurposing skills for reels, clips, and platform-native content.

· Ability to turn one long-form asset into multiple useful pieces of content across platforms.

· Excellent attention to brand detail, including correct logo, colors, typography, voice, audience, and CTA.

· Strong organization and file-management habits for content libraries, templates, raw media, approvals, and scheduled posts.

· Working knowledge of social analytics and the ability to explain what is working, what is not, and what should change.

Department: Digital Marketing – Sales & Marketing

About The Role

Farahi Law Firm is a California personal injury law firm competing in one of the most aggressive organic search markets in the country.

For us, authority is a major growth lever. This is a senior, hands-on SEO role focused specifically on link building, digital PR, and off-page authority. You will own our off-page SEO strategy end to end—from prospecting and outreach to securing high-quality editorial placements and measuring their impact.

You will work across both our English and Spanish properties, build authority around our priority practice areas and California markets, and mentor our existing Link Builder to raise the quality and effectiveness of our link acquisition efforts.

This is not a technical SEO role. Our in-house development team handles technical SEO implementation and site fixes. Your focus is building the authority that helps our content and pages compete.

Establish and document a clear placement quality standard.

Demonstrate measurable authority growth across priority practice-area and city pages.

About the job

Company Description ECON Tech delivers innovative engineering and project development solutions, with technology and research at the core of its business. The company specializes in automation, electrical systems, and information technology, integrating all levels of a plant through IT and OT to help clients build smarter operations. ECON Tech has extensive experience across industries such as iron and steel, oil and gas, petrochemical, food and beverage, automotive, manufacturing, non-ferrous metals, water treatment, pharmaceuticals, and energy. Its team of highly qualified engineers and technicians in electronics, mechatronics, information systems, and materials science brings more than 25 years of industrial project experience. ECON Tech works with leading technology platforms to design, support, and enhance production processes, including advanced process control, SCADA/HMI, PLC programming, Smart Factory 4.0 solutions, collaborative robotics and data analytics.

This position is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that integrate shop-floor automation with enterprise-level systems. Day-to-day activities include analyzing production requirements, implementing MES functionalities, configuring interfaces with PLCs, SCADA, and other control systems, and performing system testing and validation. The MES Senior Development Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional engineering teams and client stakeholders to translate process needs into robust software solutions, troubleshoot issues in live environments, and optimize system performance. The role also involves contributing to R&D initiatives, documenting technical designs, and supporting continuous improvement of MES architecture and standards across projects.

About the job

Brand Manager en Fertilidad Integral

Ubicación: Ciudad de México o Guadalajara

Modalidad: Híbrida

Área: Marketing




Sobre el rol

En Fertilidad Integral (FI) estamos buscando un/a Brand Manager que sea responsable de custodiar, fortalecer y evolucionar nuestra marca a medida que seguimos creciendo.

Este rol será el referente de marca dentro de FI, asegurando que nuestra identidad y experiencia sean consistentes en todos los puntos de contacto —desde nuestras clínicas y materiales físicos hasta nuestros canales digitales y campañas— y liderando la estrategia de comunicación y ejecución de marca para la apertura de nuevas sedes y nuestra llegada a nuevas ciudades a través de médicos aliados.

Buscamos a alguien con pensamiento estratégico, sensibilidad estética y un ojo editorial excepcional, pero que también tenga la capacidad de convertir ideas en proyectos concretos y coordinar múltiples equipos y stakeholders para hacerlas realidad.

🎨 Liderar y evolucionar nuestro sistema de marca

Ser el/la principal custodio/a de los lineamientos de marca de FI: identidad visual, tono, arquitectura verbal, tipografía, paleta y uso de logotipo.

Establecer procesos que aseguren que ningún activo se utilice fuera de los términos o vigencia de su licencia.

Trabajar de la mano con los líderes comerciales y equipos locales para asegurar un rollout exitoso.

🏥 Llevar la marca a la experiencia física

Definir los estándares visuales para materiales de clínica, eventos y otros puntos de contacto físicos.
Ser el punto de referencia interno ante cualquier duda sobre la correcta aplicación de la marca.
Liderar iniciativas de visual merchandising y ambientación de nuestras clínicas.
Asegurar una experiencia de marca consistente entre nuestras distintas sedes.

🤝 Ser consultor/a interno/a de marca

Colaborar con los equipos de Marketing, Diseño, Web, Comercial y agencias externas en decisiones que tengan impacto en la marca.
Revisar y aprobar piezas clave relacionadas con lanzamientos, campañas y nuevas líneas de servicio.
Elevar el nivel de consistencia y calidad de marca en todos los equipos de FI.

📊 Generar inteligencia de marca

Liderar benchmarks periódicos de percepción de marca frente a nuestros principales competidores.
Identificar oportunidades y gaps de posicionamiento.
Presentar recomendaciones accionables para fortalecer nuestra percepción y diferenciación.

✨ Evolucionar hacia influencers y eventos multi-sede

A partir de los primeros meses, asumir gradualmente la gestión estratégica de partnerships con influencers, incluyendo negociación de acuerdos, condiciones y exclusividades.

Desarrollo y entrega del Manual de Marca FI.
≥90% de adherencia a nuestros estándares de marca en auditorías trimestrales.

Experiencia en planificación y ejecución de eventos, activaciones o lanzamientos.
Experiencia trabajando con múltiples stakeholders y coordinando proyectos de principio a fin.

¿Por qué Fertilidad Integral?

En Fertilidad Integral estamos construyendo una de las marcas de fertilidad más relevantes de México. Este es un rol con alta visibilidad e impacto, donde tendrás la oportunidad de definir cómo se ve, se siente y se comunica FI mientras llevamos nuestra propuesta a nuevas clínicas y ciudades.

description:
About the job

About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Where we Work

Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About Your Skills


Customer Advocacy: You keep our learners, partners, and administrators at the center of your work, identifying and anticipating their needs and pain points. You thoughtfully advocate for customer needs cross-functionally. 
Project Management: You manage multiple workstreams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive customer-focused projects, adapting quickly to changes. You identify opportunities to improve processes and initiate lightweight project plans. 
Data-driven Storytelling: You analyze quantitative and qualitative data and use your technical platform expertise and critical thinking to identify keen user insights to communicate succinctly and memorably. 
Communication (English): You are fluent in the English language and can communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing 


About This Role


The Product Specialist team sits at the intersection of Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams, translating user signals into structured improvements that enhance platform quality, reduce friction, and enable scalable growth. Product Specialists equip our user-facing teams to provide a seamless user experience on our platform as well as drive user-centric platform enhancements by strategically pinpointing key challenges and opportunities to the right internal stakeholders at the right time. 
The Product Specialist team meets the challenge of internal stakeholders’ competing priorities by nimbly adjusting advocacy strategies to compliment current company priorities. As Product Specialists grow in the role, they take on higher-impact projects and partner closely with leaders in Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support. The role and these projects ensure that our users remain at the center of product and process development across our company. 


What You’ll Be Doing


Use Coursera platform expertise to advocate for and create great learner and administrator experiences by influencing roadmaps, driving issue resolution, and building creative technical solutions 
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to define and execute workflows for new feature launch operational readiness, representing our team and our learners 
Work closely with our Support teams to directly enable users by driving escalation resolution, triaging issues, and updating internal resources 
Own projects that improve our operational processes and internal tools & resources to improve our effectiveness and efficiency 
Present data-driven support insights to internal stakeholders to showcase trends and guide internal decision-making 
Build strong working relationships with multiple internal cross-functional teams and collaborate to create learners-first solutions 


What You’ll Have


3+ years of experience in customer success, technical support, or client services, working with technical teams 
Demonstrated ability to drive projects that benefit clients, customers, or end users 
Experience with mastering a technical platform and providing technical consultative support 
Written and verbal communication skills (English) to communicate technical information clearly, succinctly, and professionally 


At Udemy, we strive to be transparent around compensation. Actual compensation for this role is based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition to a base salary, this role is also eligible for equity.

Hiring Compensation Range

$440,000—$550,000 MXN

Why work here?

You’ll grow here.

Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

AI is real here.

We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.

You’ll own your work.

We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. You don’t need to wait for permission or layers of approval to have an impact.

You’ll Build With Others.

We collaborate openly and shape ideas together. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.

You’ll see your impact.

What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?

Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s LEARN together. 

Our Benefits Start With U

Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. Benefits vary by region, and we encourage applicants to review our Australia Benefits, India Benefits, Ireland Benefits, Mexico Benefits, Turkiye Benefits & US Benefits, pages to get an understanding of some of the benefits we offer. For details on region-specific benefits, please refer to the information provided during the hiring process.

Benefits outlined are provided as a general overview and may vary depending on the location, role, and employment classification. All benefits are subject to change at the discretion of the organization and in accordance with applicable laws and policies.

At Udemy, we value diversity and inclusion and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or disability. We understand that not everyone will match each of the qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you! 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. description:
About the job

Brand Manager – Teamfight Tactics 

Brand Management at Riot is focused on players and fans. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and creating meaningful experiences across every touchpoint. For Teamfight Tactics, this means celebrating the strategy, creativity, and competitive mastery at the heart of the game while growing a passionate global community around it.

As a Brand Manager II for Teamfight Tactics, you will primarily lead publishing and brand marketing efforts for TFT Esports (approx. 80% of your scope) while supporting broader TFT publishing initiatives and evergreen brand priorities (approx. 20%). You'll help strengthen TFT's competitive identity through integrated campaigns, compelling storytelling, and player-first experiences that celebrate the game's global esports ecosystem. 80% Esports / 20% Game

This is a highly collaborative role that works across Creative, Communications, Social, Regional Publishing, Esports Product, Broadcast, Community, and Production teams to deliver impactful campaigns that grow fandom and support business outcomes.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Brand Marketing and this role can be based in Mexico city or LAX.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Campaign Leadership


Steward the TFT Esports brand by developing marketing and communications strategies that strengthen its competitive identity and deepen player fandom.
Lead integrated global marketing campaigns for esports events, tournaments, and competitive moments, from brief through launch, measurement, and retrospective.
Translate player and audience insights into compelling creative briefs, campaign strategies, and marketing plans.
Support broader TFT publishing initiatives throughout the year, contributing to game campaigns and evergreen brand priorities beyond the esports calendar.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Global Publishing


Partner with Esports Product, Broadcast, Competitive Operations, Social, Community, Influencer, and Regional Publishing teams to develop aligned global marketing plans.
Partner with regional publishing teams by providing creative frameworks, marketing assets, and best practices that enable locally relevant execution while maintaining global brand consistency.
Collaborate with Insights, Business Development, Product, and Live Experiences teams to identify opportunities that strengthen the TFT player experience and esports ecosystem.


Creative & Operational Excellence


Steward creative development across esports marketing initiatives, ensuring work reflects TFT's brand, competitive spirit, and player experience.
Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agency relationships, and production partners to deliver high-quality work that is on strategy, on time, and on budget.
Stay closely connected to the TFT community, competitive scene, and broader gaming landscape to identify emerging opportunities and inform future marketing initiatives.


Required Qualifications


3 to 5 years of experience in brand management, product marketing, community marketing, or agency roles within gaming, entertainment, or esports.
Deep understanding of the TFT esports landscape and a nuanced grasp of the players, fans, creators, and communities that shape its competitive ecosystem.
Experience developing and executing integrated marketing and communications campaigns from planning through launch.
Strong understanding of brand fundamentals and experience translating player or audience insights into effective marketing strategies.
Experience working with gaming audiences, live events, or community-driven marketing initiatives.
Experience collaborating across cross-functional and international teams to deliver shared goals.
Experience working with agencies, creative partners, or production teams to bring campaigns to life.
Experience using campaign performance data and audience insights to evaluate campaign performance and optimize future marketing efforts.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.


Desired Qualifications


Familiarity with Teamfight Tactics, Riot Games' portfolio, or competitive strategy games.
Experience partnering with esports product, broadcast, live event production, or game development teams.
Understanding of creative production workflows and integrated global marketing campaigns.
Awareness of emerging trends across gaming, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle marketing.
Active TFT player and engaged member of the TFT community.


You have strong marketing instincts, enjoy collaborating across disciplines, and care deeply about creating campaigns that resonate with players and fans. You balance creativity with thoughtful execution and are motivated by delivering experiences that strengthen TFT's competitive identity and long-term fandom.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks

Perks: Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k/Private Pension Plan with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Duties

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:


Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks

About the job

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team 

At Fever, our Business Development team is both the face of Fever in the market and the voice of the market within Fever. Sitting at the core of our platform, they connect the world’s best experiences with the largest audiences, helping the live entertainment industry grow and evolve.

Our team builds trusted, long-term partnerships with leading brands across the ecosystem. We work closely with creators, producers, agencies, and cultural leaders to help them make data-driven decisions, expand their portfolios, and scale internationally. In doing so, we play a key role in shaping the future of the entertainment landscape.

This role goes far beyond relationship management. It requires strong strategic thinking and problem-solving across a wide range of topics, from marketing and pricing to operations and financing. The most successful team members take full ownership of their partners’ success, acting as true partners and advisors at every stage of growth.

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Business Development works hand-in-hand with Marketing, Category Management, Partner Support, Operations, Tech, Product, and Finance to ensure every experience on our platform reaches its full potential.

Our team is diverse, entrepreneurial, and dynamic, bringing together talent from consulting, banking, big tech, and startups. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where creativity meets data, and ambition meets execution.

Join us if you’re passionate about discovering world-class experiences, building meaningful partnerships, and scaling some of the most exciting concepts across the globe.

The Role

In this role, you will drive Fever’s expansion across Mexico's entertainment industry by building and nurturing deep commercial relationships with top producers, creators, venues, and key stakeholders. You will develop and execute an innovative growth strategy to scale our market presence, expertly managing commercial strategies to ensure mutual value creation and build sustainable, long-term partnerships with event organizers. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams both in Mexico and internationally, you will successfully balance a growing client base while serving as our in-house expert on the coolest trends and newest experiences in the entertainment landscape.

What You'll Do


Develop and deliver a growth strategy for the market, with an innovative and effective approach to scaling Fever's presence in the region
Expertly manage commercial strategy with large partners ensuring value creation for both parties, and a sustainable strategic partnership between Fever and event organisers
Create and cultivate deep business relationships with the biggest producers, creators, venues and key stakeholders in the entertainment industry

Collaborate closely with cross functional stakeholders to successfully deliver on partner growth across Mexico and internationally
Keep up to date with everything cool that’s happening in the entertainment; think of yourself as the expert for new and trending experiences


Who You Are

At least 5+ years of top tier consulting or top tech equivalent experience, plus another 4+ years of relevant experience.
Strong business development and partnership management skills
Self-starter mentality with an ability to work in a demanding, dynamic start-up environment

About the job

Estamos buscando Analista de Resurtido y Demanda para puntos de venta físicos en una empresa de expansión que comercializa productos cosméticos y de belleza. 




Te encargarás de asegurar la disponibilidad óptima de productos en las tiendas, evitando quiebres de stock y sobreinventario. En tu día a día analizarás datos de ventas, históricos de demanda y tendencias de consumo, y elaborarás planes de resurtido alineados con los objetivos comerciales. Trabajarás de forma estrecha con los equipos de ventas, logística y trade marketing para coordinar pedidos, lanzamientos y promociones en tienda. 

También generarás informes periódicos de desempeño de categorías y productos clave, proponiendo acciones de mejora basadas en indicadores. Este es un puesto a tiempo completo, presencial, localizado en Ciudad de México, México.




Responsabilidades 

-Ejecutar el ciclo semanal de resurtido por tienda y SKU con base en venta promedio móvil, días de inventario, stock de seguridad, lead time y mínimos de exhibición. 

-Mantener y afinar parámetros de inventario: mínimos, máximos, punto de reorden y cobertura objetivo por categoría y por tipo de tienda. 

-Diferenciar el surtido según el tipo de plaza, dado que el perfil de cliente y la velocidad de venta cambian entre aeropuerto, centro comercial, metro y regional. 

-Detectar quiebres de stock antes de que ocurran e identificar sobre-inventario y producto de baja rotación, proponiendo transferencias entre tiendas. 

-Controlar caducidades y rotación PEPS del producto. 

-Reportar semanalmente nivel de servicio, quiebres, semanas de inventario, rotación y sell-through de lanzamientos. 

-Coordinarse de forma permanente con compras e importación, almacén y operaciones de tienda.

Licenciatura en Ingeniería Industrial, Logística, Administración, Economía, Actuaría o afín. Titulado o pasante.

About the job

Job Description

At Zendesk, we’re revolutionizing what’s possible in Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES). Our rapid innovation and Agentic AI leadership have earned the trust of thousands of forward-thinking businesses.

We are seeking a Sales Engineer (SE) to join our presales organization. This role is ideal for a tech-savvy professional who is eager to master the art of solution selling in a presales environment. You will work alongside Account Executives to understand mid-market customer requirements, configure compelling software demonstrations, and explain the power of Zendesk’s core platform and AI solutions. You will focus on building deep product expertise and delivering flawless execution of standard sales cycles.

You’ll be aligned to the AMER region, with a strong focus on English speaking customers, so excellent English is a need.

What You’ll Be Doing


Deliver Tailored Demonstrations: Configure and deliver engaging, value-mapped product presentations showcasing Zendesk’s core capabilities, including automated AI agents and messaging workflows.
Support Discovery & Scoping: Assist in technical discovery conversations to uncover operational challenges, system dependencies, and integration requirements from prospects.
Build Standard POCs: Build out standard sandbox environments and proof-of-concept setups that accurately validate Zendesk’s ability to solve the customer’s immediate requirements.
Address Technical Questionnaires: Take ownership of standard security, architectural, and RFP/RFI questionnaires to support deal progression.
Leverage Internal Best Practices: Adopt internal framework templates, scripts, and pre-built API recipes to ensure high-quality and consistent technical deliverables.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent practical technology experience.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in solution engineering, technical support, implementation consulting, or customer success within a B2B SaaS environment.
Technical Basics: Comfortable working with APIs, JSON structures, webhooks, and modern web browser troubleshooting tools.
AI Fluency: AI-fluent with a strong understanding of the generative AI landscape, model capabilities, and conversational workflow architecture.
Domain Knowledge: Baseline understanding of customer service metrics, CRM systems, or standard help desk workflows.
Travel Commitment: Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% annually for regional customer presentations and team events.


Preferred Qualifications


Basic knowledge of a scripting language like JavaScript or standard data structures.
Strong written communication skills with experience answering technical questionnaires or documentation requests.
Strong English skills.


Who You Are


Customer obsessed: The customer comes first, and you believe that through and through. We are here to delight the customer with the ability to give them what they need in CX before they even know it.
A Builder First: You have a passion for code, deep system configurations, and getting your hands dirty building the future of software.
Strategically Minded: You naturally tie advanced technical mechanisms directly to strategic business metrics, ROI, and organizational transformation.
Resilient & Collaborative: You thrive in high-stakes environments, working cross-functionally across complex international teams to drive a unified go-to-market strategy.

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

title: Growth & Customer Success Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Key Account Manager (KAM) en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y nuestro negocio de pagos (POS y online) crece fuerte en México. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar — y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




📍 Modalidad 100% presencial – base en México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.




Tu desafío: Vender. Tu cancha es nuestra base instalada de comercios: no vienes a cuidar cuentas, vienes a hacerlas crecer y cerrar ventas de POS. Vas a cazar oportunidades dentro de la cartera, subir el volumen que cada comercio procesa con AgendaPro, ganarles terreno a los competidores y convertir una base de alto potencial —hoy con poco relacionamiento comercial— en volumen real. Hay más de 300 cuentas esperando que alguien las active de verdad. Esa es tu meta.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Vender POS a los comercios de nuestra base actual y cumplir (o reventar) tus metas de venta.

• Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor (llamadas, visitas presenciales, revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant).

• Subir la penetración GPV/GMV del POS: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujarlo hacia 60% / 70%; diagnosticar por qué cada uno no procesa más (fricción técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features) y cerrar la brecha.

• Ganarle al arbitraje: detectar los comercios que usan AgendaPro pero también procesan tarjeta en un POS de la competencia, y recuperar ese volumen para nosotros.

• Retención / anti-churn: intervenir apenas una cuenta cae bajo el umbral o muestra señales de fuga.

• Aplicar pricing táctico dentro de los guardrails definidos.

• Coordinar con el equipo comercial en México: asumes la relación comercial y coordinas la mantención con operación y soporte, escalando los temas operativos y de producto a las contrapartes internas.

• Recibir los comercios recién activados (desde activación / onboarding) y asumir su relación de crecimiento.

• Reportar avance: alimentar los dashboards de penetración, GPV por cuenta y arbitraje, y participar en los ritmos semanales del equipo de Payments.




Requisitos: 

• Formación en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.

• 2–4 años en account management / KAM / customer success o gestión de cartera B2B, idealmente en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Orientación a GPV (volumen procesado), no a número de llamadas; track record de crecer revenue/engagement en cartera existente, no solo adquisición.

• Capacidad de leer data y dashboards, identificar patrones y priorizar comercios por oportunidad.

• Comunicación empática pero directa; cómodo visitando comercios y teniendo conversaciones difíciles.

• Autonomía y disciplina de seguimiento; trabaja en equipo con los hunters y activación sin competir (roles complementarios).




Suma puntos:

• Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Experiencia en el sector belleza, salud o bienestar.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos mexicano (Clip, Mercado Pago, Getnet, Netpay, bancos adquirentes)

2. Renovación y desarrollo de cuentas

3. Coordinación y atención al cliente

description:

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb, a global leader in the travel and hospitality industry, is dedicated to creating a world where anyone can belong anywhere. With our unique accommodations and experiences, we connect travelers with local hosts across the globe. As we continue to innovate and grow, we're looking for dynamic individuals to join our team and help shape our trajectory.

The Difference You Will Make

Airbnb is seeking a Lead, Advanced Analytics, Hosting Services to support the growth of Airbnb's initiatives in the Hosting Services space, including the Co-Host Network, Host Referrals program, and Superhost Ambassadors program. This role is pivotal in analyzing the success of these supply programs across countries and host segments to better understand the drivers of key business, financial, and engagement metrics. The individual in this role will focus on in-depth data analysis, statistical modeling, metric definition, impact assessment, experimentation, and synthesis of insights to inform prioritization.

A Typical Day


Conduct advanced data analysis and statistical modeling to extract actionable insights that inform strategic decisions across key geographical markets and host segments. 
Manage stakeholder relationships across the homes supply team, ensuring clarity of communication and strategic alignment on analytics initiatives. 
Analyze broad data to understand the drivers of new listing supply, availability, revenue, churn and other key metrics related to host needs and engagement. 
Define new metrics and identify leading indicators of key business outcomes. 
Build dashboards and data pipelines to track key performance metrics across markets and host segments to establish benchmarks. 
Develop and support agentic workflows and AI-assisted tools to automate recurring data analysis and reporting tasks, improving the speed and scale of insights delivery and enabling self-serve access to data across the homes supply team. 
Conduct A/B tests to improve business performance and maximize incrementality. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Strategic Finance, Data and Analytical Engineering, and Data Science, to align strategies and leverage synergies. 


Your Expertise


A quantitative undergraduate degree with a strong preference for candidates holding an MBA or equivalent advanced degree, with 8+ years of industry experience in a Data Science, Analytics, or equivalent role. 
Prior experience in advanced analytics or business data science within a marketplace or business strategy setting. 
Deep technical expertise in data analysis, statistical modeling, experimentation and causal inference, familiarity with LLMs, and experience applying these skills to derive insights from broad data sets. 
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking skills, and the ability to make informed judgments. 
Excellent communication skills, capable of engaging with a variety of stakeholders and conveying complex concepts in an accessible manner. 
Proven stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate and influence across functions. 
An agile, growth-minded approach, demonstrated through a history of driving projects from ideation to impact. 


Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. Do you think you are a fit for this role but decided not to apply? Please tell us why.

About Us

We are a growing commercial landscaping company serving property managers, HOAs, multifamily communities, retail centers, office parks, business owners, and other commercial clients.

Yes, we mow grass, clean beds, trim shrubs, fix irrigation, handle seasonal color, and keep properties looking sharp.

But the real business we are in is trust.

Our clients are busy. They do not want to babysit their landscaping company. They do not want to send the same email three times. They do not want vague updates. They do not want “let me check on that” followed by silence.

They want someone who owns the issue, communicates clearly, follows through, and makes their life easier.

That is what this role is for.

We are hiring a Client Success / Customer Experience Lead who can help us build a client experience that is way better than what most local service businesses deliver.

This is a remote role through ScaleSource, but this is not a low-level assistant role. This is a leadership-level communication, execution, and follow-up seat.

You will be expected to think, lead, solve, track, follow up, and make sure things actually get done.

If you need to be told every step, this is not the role.

If you see problems, organize chaos, chase answers, communicate clearly, and make sure the ball does not get dropped, you may be exactly who we need.

The Big Picture

Our Standard Is Simple:

No client should ever have to wonder where something stands.

If a client has a question, complaint, issue, request, project update, scheduling concern, irrigation problem, billing question, or property concern, we need that item captured, clarified, assigned, tracked, updated, and completed.

Our goal is that most client issues or requests are resolved within 72 hours or less.

Next day is better.

Same day is beautiful.

But even when something cannot be solved immediately, the client should still receive clear, honest, proactive updates so they know we are on it.

We do not need someone who says, “I passed the message along.”

We Need Someone Who Says:

“I found the issue, confirmed who owns it, tracked the next step, updated the client, followed up with operations, and confirmed it was completed.”

That is the difference.

Role Mission

Your mission is to help us deliver world-class communication and client experience in a business where things move fast, weather changes plans, crews are in the field, clients have urgent needs, and details can easily get lost.

You will be the person helping make sure they do not get lost.

You will work between clients, field leadership, operations, admin, and ownership to make sure communication is clear and execution is tracked.

You are not just answering emails.

You are helping lead the customer experience.

What You’ll Own1. Client Communication

You will communicate with commercial clients through email, phone, text, client portals, CRM systems, video updates, and virtual meetings.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Responding to client messages quickly and professionally
Sending clear updates before clients have to chase us
Explaining what happened, what we are doing, who is responsible, and when the next update will happen
Communicating delays, weather issues, scheduling changes, property concerns, and service updates
Making clients feel heard without overpromising nonsense we cannot deliver
Keeping communication honest, calm, warm, and professional
Making us feel like the most organized landscaping company they have ever worked with


The goal is not to sound fancy.

The goal is to be clear, useful, trustworthy, and fast.


 Issue Ownership and 72-Hour Follow-Through


When a client reports an issue, you do not just forward it and hope someone handles it.

You own the communication loop until the item is completed.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Capturing the issue clearly
Asking good questions when the request is vague
Confirming property, location, priority, photos, timing, and client expectation
Assigning or escalating the issue to the correct internal person
Tracking the status until completion
Following up with operations or field leadership
Updating the client proactively
Confirming completion with notes, photos, or internal confirmation when possible
Closing the loop so everyone knows the issue was handled


Our standard is that client asks and issues should be completed or clearly moved forward within 72 hours whenever possible.

If something will take longer, the client still gets a real update.

No disappearing.

No vague “checking on it.”

No black holes.


 Problem Identification and Solutions


This role requires leadership judgment.

You should be able to identify patterns and problems before they become bigger problems.

For Example:


A client keeps asking about the same issue
A property keeps having the same service complaint
A crew keeps missing the same detail
A work order is stuck with no update
A client has not heard from us in too long
A property manager seems frustrated even if they are being polite
A process is clearly broken and causing repeat confusion


Your job is not just to report problems.

Your job is to help create solutions.

You Should Be Able To Say:

“Here is the issue I am seeing. Here is the pattern. Here is what I recommend we do. Here is who needs to own it. Here is how I will track it.”

That is the level we need.


 Execution Tracking


You will help make sure the company has a clean system for tracking client requests, property issues, service updates, and internal follow-up.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Creating and updating tasks
Keeping CRM/client records clean
Tracking open issues by client/property
Maintaining follow-up dates and deadlines
Confirming completion instead of assuming completion
Helping leadership see what is open, stuck, urgent, or recurring
Preparing simple weekly reports on client issues, aging items, completed items, and recurring concerns
Making sure communication does not live only in someone’s memory, text thread, or random notebook


This role exists because “I think someone is handling it” is how businesses stay mediocre.

We are not doing that.


 Video Updates and Client Meetings


You must be comfortable on video.

This Role May Include:


Recording short Loom-style client updates
Showing your face on camera while explaining an update
Sharing your screen to walk through photos, notes, schedules, open items, or reports
Joining virtual meetings with clients
Joining internal team meetings
Helping create a more human, clear, and professional client experience


You do not need to be a news anchor.

Actually, please do not be a news anchor.

You need to be clear, confident, real, and professional.

Clients should feel like there is a smart human being paying attention.


 Bilingual Team Communication


This role requires strong English and Spanish.

You will often need to help communication flow between English-speaking clients or managers and Spanish-speaking field team members.

You Must Be Able To:


Write excellent English emails and updates
Speak clearly and professionally in English
Communicate effectively in Spanish
Clarify details between team members
Translate or summarize information accurately when needed
Avoid confusion caused by vague communication


Your English needs to be client-ready. Not “pretty good.” Not “I can get by.”

Client-ready.

Our Core Values and Mindset

We care a lot about fit. Skills matter, but mindset matters more.


 FITFO — Figure It The Freak Out


We need people who can think.

You will not always have perfect instructions. That is real life.

When something is unclear, we expect you to ask smart questions, look for context, make a recommendation, and keep moving.

Not panic.

Not disappear.

Not wait three days for someone to spoon-feed the answer.

Figure it out.


 Own It


Ownership means the problem does not have to be your fault for it to become your responsibility.

If a client issue lands with you, you own the communication loop until it is closed.

You do not get to say, “I sent it to operations” and wash your hands of it.

You follow up. You track. You confirm. You close the loop.


 Communicate Early and Honestly


Bad news early is useful.

Bad news late is expensive.

We do not need perfect updates. We need honest updates.

If something is delayed, say it clearly. If we made a mistake, communicate professionally. If you do not know yet, say what you are doing to find out and when the next update will happen.

Clients can handle issues.

They hate silence.


 No Dropped Balls


This role is for someone who hates loose ends.

You should be the kind of person who gets mildly annoyed when tasks are floating around with no owner, no due date, and no follow-up plan.

That annoyance is useful here.


 Calm Is a Superpower


Commercial landscaping can get messy.

Weather happens. Crews run late. Clients get frustrated. Irrigation breaks. Properties get missed. Someone forgets to send photos. A manager needs an answer now.

We need someone who stays calm, clear, and useful.

Drama does not help. Ownership does.


 Make the Company Better


We are not hiring you to maintain broken systems.

We are hiring you to help improve them.

If you see a better way to track issues, communicate updates, organize client notes, or prevent repeat problems, speak up and help build it.

What Success Looks Like

You Are Winning In This Role If:


Clients feel informed, respected, and taken care of
Client requests are usually resolved or meaningfully advanced within 72 hours
Open issues are tracked clearly with owners, due dates, and next steps
Clients receive proactive updates before they have to ask
Operations knows exactly what clients need and what is urgent
Recurring client issues are identified and escalated
Leadership can quickly see what is open, stuck, completed, or becoming a pattern
Client communication feels organized, human, and professional
Nothing important gets lost in email, text, WhatsApp, CRM notes, or someone’s brain
You make the business feel calmer, cleaner, and more accountable


Required Qualifications

Please do not apply unless you meet these requirements.


5+ years of customer service, client success, account management, operations coordination, executive assistant, or client-facing admin experience
3+ years working directly with U.S.-based clients or U.S.-based companies
2+ years working remotely in a role that required independent ownership and follow-up
Fluent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level
Fluent or highly advanced Spanish communication skills
Proven experience managing 50+ client/customer interactions, tickets, tasks, or follow-up items per week
Proven experience tracking issues through a CRM, help desk, project management tool, spreadsheet, or similar system
Ability to write clear client-facing updates with strong grammar, structure, and tone
Comfortable recording video updates with yourself on camera
Comfortable joining virtual client meetings
Comfortable making phone calls or voice calls when needed
Strong organization skills with a real personal system for tracking work
Strong ability to identify problems, recommend solutions, and follow through
Must be available during core U.S. business hours


Preferred Qualifications

These are not all required, but they are a big plus.


Experience in landscaping, construction, property management, home services, trades, field services, facilities management, or another service business
Experience supporting commercial clients or property managers
Experience with work orders, service tickets, scheduling, estimates, invoicing, or job tracking
Experience using Loom or similar video tools
Experience using CRMs, help desk systems, or project management software
Experience creating client reports or leadership updates
Experience working with bilingual field teams
Experience improving a process, not just following one


Tools You May Use

You do not need to know all of these, but you need to be tech-comfortable and able to learn quickly.


Gmail / Google Workspace
Google Sheets
CRM systems
Jobber, Aspire, LMN, Service Autopilot, Yardbook, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
Loom or similar video recording tools
Slack, WhatsApp, or other internal messaging tools
Zoom / Google Meet
QuickBooks or other invoicing systems
Client portals or work order systems


If learning a new tool stresses you out, this is probably not your seat.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:


Loves creating order out of chaos
Takes pride in being the person who actually follows through
Can handle a frustrated client without getting defensive
Knows how to be warm without being fluffy
Knows how to be direct without being rude
Can manage a lot of moving pieces
Notices when something feels off
Is willing to chase an answer until the answer exists
Can lead from a remote seat
Wants to be part of building something much bigger and better than a normal landscaping company


Who This Role Is NOT For

This Role Is Not For Someone Who:


Needs to be told what to do all day
Waits quietly when something is unclear
Gets overwhelmed by multiple open tasks
Avoids difficult conversations
Is uncomfortable on camera
Writes sloppy English
Says “I’ll check on that” and then forgets
Thinks forwarding a message counts as ownership
Does not like systems, tracking, or follow-up
Wants a simple inbox-only customer service job


This is a leadership support role. You will have help, but you must bring brainpower, ownership, and urgency.

How to apply

We know your CV might not be up to date. Send what you have.

You'll be asked a few questions. Specific, numbers-based answers are expected. This helps us filter the best candidates at early stages of the process. If you have the right experience and you put the effort, it will be noticed. Vague answers won't move forward.

A short video submission might be required at the right stage of the process.

Everyone gets a response within 24 business hours.

About the job

Ilir Sela started Slice with the belief that local pizzerias deserve all of the advantages of major franchises without compromising their independence. Starting with his family’s pizzerias, we now empower over tens of thousands of restaurants with the technology, services, and collective power that owners need to better serve their digitally minded customers and build lasting businesses. We’re growing and adding more talent to help fulfil this valuable mission. That’s where you come in.

The Challenge to Solve

Slice CRM sits at a genuinely unusual intersection: two audiences (consumers and shop owners), four active channels (email, push, in-app, and SMS), and a mission (More Bigger Orders) that requires both sides of the equation to work. The consumer side demands lifecycle automation that drives repeat purchase and habit formation. The shop owner side is newer territory: an SMS-first program built to educate and engage independent operators, giving them the ability to compete with large franchise models. The foundation is being built, and we need someone who can assist in constructing it while running the programs that depend on it.

The Role

As CRM Lead, you'll be hands-on. Your primary domain is Braze (Canvas flows, segmentation, campaign architecture, subscription group logic), and you'll operate at the intersection of CRM and data, collaborating with technical partners on the infrastructure that unlocks the next generation of automation. You'll own campaign execution, QA, and platform hygiene while also contributing to how we sequence and evolve our broader CRM strategy across both audiences.

The Team

You'll join a small, high-output CRM team working across B2C and B2B audiences in close partnership with marketing, data and engineering. Visibility is high. CRM is a priority at the leadership level, and your work will be seen.

The Winning Recipe 

We're Looking For Someone Equally Comfortable As The Architect And The Builder, Someone Who Can Hold The Strategic Picture While Doing Precise, Reliable Execution Work In Braze. These Are The Core Competencies


3–5 years in marketing ops, CRM, or growth ops, ideally in a multi-channel B2C and B2B environment with transactional or marketplace dynamics
Deep Braze experience: Canvas flows, segmentation, content blocks, subscription groups, and campaign QA. You've maintained these systems, not just used them
Technical fluency: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and Liquid personalization for dynamic content in emails and messaging

Familiarity with incrementality thinking: holdout groups, control logic, and understanding the difference between correlation and lift
Communication: Fluent written and verbal English skills, with the ability to communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences
Bonus: experience building an SMS program from the ground up


The Extras

Working at Slice comes with a comprehensive set of benefits, but here are some of the unexpected highlights:


Premium healthcare, dental, and optical coverage
25 days PTO
Wellbeing stipend

About the job

Cardiometabolic Marketing Department

Mexico City

Every touchpoint matters. In this role, you'll shape the strategies that help millions of people start and stay on life-changing treatments — turning consumer data into real health outcomes across one of the fastest-growing therapeutic areas in the industry. We are hiring two Conversion & Retention Coordinators to strengthen our growing team in Mexico City.

Your new role

In this role, you will be at the centre of our consumer conversion and retention efforts, coordinating campaigns and initiatives that help patients start and stay on therapy. You'll combine data-driven thinking with hands-on execution to optimise how consumers move through their health journey.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Coordinating targeted consumer conversion and retention campaigns across multiple channels, ensuring timely delivery aligned with commercial objectives
Analysing consumer journey behaviour to identify friction points, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve progression and retention
Tracking key performance indicators and recommending data-informed optimisation actions across campaigns and engagement initiatives
Collaborating with Sales, Trade Marketing, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and external partners to ensure seamless execution
Preparing regular performance reports, supporting budget tracking, vendor coordination, and maintaining accurate documentation


Your new department

You will join the Cardiometabolic Marketing Department, a dynamic team focused on strengthening consumer engagement across our growing cardiometabolic portfolio. The team works at the intersection of marketing strategy, consumer insights, and cross-functional collaboration — all with a shared commitment to helping more patients access and benefit from treatment. You will report to the Acquisition Manager and work alongside passionate colleagues who thrive in a fast-paced, data-rich environment.

Your Skills & Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is organised, analytical, and energised by the challenge of improving consumer engagement at scale. To succeed in this role, you'll bring:


A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field
3–5 years of experience in consumer acquisition, retention, digital marketing, or commercial marketing, including campaign performance analysis and reporting
Advanced proficiency in both Spanish and English is required.
Strong project management and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously
A customer-centric mindset with a results-oriented approach and a keen eye for journey optimisation opportunities


Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job — you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Deadline

9 September 2025. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We’re not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.

title: Editor de Operaciones Digitales con IA
description:
About the job

Somos un grupo de medios digitales en crecimiento y buscamos a la persona que supervise nuestra operación de contenido asistida por inteligencia artificial. No vas a redactar notas: vas a revisarlas, aprobarlas y mejorar el sistema que las produce. Es un rol de criterio y de procesos, no de producción manual.




Es un puesto nuevo, con capacitación completa de nuestra parte. Buscamos a alguien de medios que quiera dar el salto a la operación editorial con IA, una de las habilidades más demandadas del sector.




QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA

• Revisar y aprobar contenido generado con herramientas de IA (notas informativas y videos) antes de su publicación, cuidando calidad, precisión y línea editorial.

• Detectar errores recurrentes y corregirlos en la fuente: mejorar las instrucciones y guías editoriales que alimentan al sistema, no corregir a mano nota por nota.

• Coordinar la publicación de contenido en varios sitios de noticias y sus redes sociales.

• Monitorear el desempeño orgánico de las páginas de Facebook (horarios, formatos, alcance) y proponer ajustes.

• Documentar procesos y participar en la retroalimentación semanal con la dirección.




REQUISITOS

• Licenciatura en Comunicación, Periodismo o experiencia equivalente en medios.

• 2 a 4 años de experiencia en medios digitales (redacción web, edición o coordinación de contenidos).

• Redacción y ortografía impecables, y criterio editorial sólido: saber qué se puede afirmar y qué no en temas judiciales, políticos y delicados.

• Curiosidad tecnológica real y disposición a trabajar todos los días con herramientas de IA (te capacitamos, pero las ganas las traes tú).

• Organización, autonomía y discreción absoluta. Se firma acuerdo de confidencialidad.




NO NECESITAS

• Saber programar. Ninguna parte del puesto requiere código.

• Experiencia previa con IA. Requiere criterio de editor; la herramienta se aprende aquí.




OFRECEMOS

• Sueldo de $18,000 a $20,000 brutos mensuales según experiencia, con esquema de crecimiento a los 6 meses.

• Bonos por desempeño.

• Horario flexible: el puesto se mide por resultados, no por horas frente al escritorio.

• Modalidad híbrida o 100% remota, según tu ubicación y preferencia.

• Prestaciones de ley.

• Capacitación directa en operación editorial con IA, con proyectos reales desde la primera semana.




CÓMO APLICAR

Envía tu CV y portafolio (links de páginas, cuentas o medios que hayas manejado, con tu rol y periodo) a talento@emasmedios.com con el asunto "Editor Operaciones IA". Te responderemos con dos ejercicios cortos de criterio editorial y creatividad; solo avanzan quienes los completan.
